text: Return policy: Customers can return unused products within 30 days of purchase. Items must be in original packaging with proof of purchase.
Refunds: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the returned item is inspected.
Damaged items: Customers must report damaged or defective products within 48 hours of delivery to receive a replacement or refund.
Shipping policy: We offer both domestic and international shipping to most countries worldwide.
Delivery time: Domestic orders are delivered within 3 to 5 business days, while international orders take 7 to 14 business days.
Payment methods: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, PayPal, and net banking.
Customer support: You can contact support via email at support@example.com or by calling 1800-123-456.
Warranty policy: Most electronic products come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty.
